company.text: American Esoteric Laboratories (Memphis, TN) began as the pathologist-owned Memphis Pathology Laboratory and was acquired by **Sonic Healthcare** in 2007 (reported at US$180M). It is CAP-accredited and CLIA-approved, with a core lab in Memphis, AEL East in Knoxville, and labs in Mississippi and Arkansas. Molecular testing covers bacterial, viral and protozoan pathogens by nucleic-acid amplification; microbiology includes bacteriology, mycobacteriology, mycology, parasitology, virology and MALDI-TOF; genetics covers inherited disorders, oncology, pharmacogenetics and reproductive testing (NIPS, prenatal).

financials.text: AEL does not report separately. **Sonic FY2026 (to Jun 2026):** revenue A$10,867M (+13%). **USA:** A$2,048M (19% of group), down 3% statutory and **flat organic** in constant currency (2% underlying), after losing a major Alabama payor contract and restructuring anatomical pathology. Sonic's US **advanced diagnostics division** (Cairo Diagnostics, ThyroSeq and other specialised testing) grew **16% organically** — the part of Sonic USA where a specialised genomics tool is most likely to land.
